description:
Cancels the active plan now: the monthly card subscription stops, and a purchase under 7 days is refunded.
Send `{ "accept_data_removal": true }`: what the plan added ends now (`account.cancel.losses` in `GET /api/plans` says what), including a period already paid that has not started yet, such as a renewal. A purchase made less than 7 days ago and a paid period that has not started go back the same way they were paid (card or Pix); USDC is refunded by the team. Original PDFs are free. An active plan includes usage.total, usage.used and usage.remaining. One page uses 1 unit, a price report 25, an alert 5 and a tender watch 3. Allowance is consumed before prepaid credit.

accept_data_removal.description: Must be `true`: you accept losing what the plan added.

name: cancel_plan
title: Cancel plan
